blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian and Senators Erwin Tulfo and Panfilo Lacson on Thursday rejected Vice President Sara Duterte’s claim that the 2027 budget could be used to pressure senator-judges to convict her. Gatchalian denied that the proposed national budget was being dangled before senator-judges in exchange for their votes. “There is no such thing… In fact, the budget is not in any way connected to the judgment in the impeachment trial. The direction of the impeachment is to render an impartial and fair judgment,” he told reporters. “There’s no basis for that kind of allegation,” he added. He […]...
